planets.name: TOI-6034 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-6034 with a 2.58-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-6034 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-6034. Its orbit and size follow Kanodia et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname KANODIA_ET_AL_2024): disc_year 2024, disc_facility Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS), sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 2.576184, pl_radj 1.063, pl_bmassj 0.798

quotes.title: TOI-6034 b
quotes.card: TOI-6034 b is an exoplanet about 385 light-years away from the Earth.
quotes.introduction: It was first discovered by NASA’s Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS) and its discovery was announced in 2024.
